description: Browse the Hire agents catalog and hire a pre-configured team in a few clicks.

Hiring Agents

title: Managing Your Agents
description: Edit team settings, pause and archive teams, and find them in the Teams page.
body:
Managing Your Agents

Day-to-day team management happens in two places: the Teams page for lifecycle actions, and each team's Settings tab for configuration.

Edit a team's settings

Click Teams in the sidebar.
Click the team you want to edit.
Open the Settings tab.

From here you can edit:

Role - The plain-language description of who the team is.

description: Send instructions to an agent in the Chat tab and get good results back.
body:
Messaging Your Agent

The Chat tab is your direct line to an agent. Send instructions, ask for status, and review responses in a familiar messaging interface.

Send a message

Click Teams in the sidebar.
Click the team you want to message.
Open the Chat tab.
Type your message in the input field.

title: Planning Your AI Workforce
description: How to scope agent roles, choose autonomy, and add the right connections as you add more teams.
body:
Planning Your AI Workforce

Adding one agent is easy. As you add more, the choices that matter are role scope, autonomy, and connections. This article walks through each.

Scope each team narrowly

Vague mandates like "General Research Team" or "Marketing AI" make it hard to write good instructions and hard to know which connections the team actually needs.

Start each team with a specific job.

title: What is an Agent?
description: What an agent is, how it's structured, and where to find one in the Liftoff interface.
body:
What is an Agent?

An agent handles a specific role in your workspace. Send them work in their Chat tab and they carry it out using the tools and connections you've authorized.
